services.desc: 2.5-hour guided family trips on Lake Tahoe from 4-6:30 PM-an affordable, relaxed way to experience Tahoe fishing together. Looking for a shorter, family-friendly fishing trip on Lake Tahoe? Our new Family Charters run from 4:00 PM to 6:30 PM and are designed specifically for families and small groups who want to experience fishing without committing to a full half-day on the water. These trips offer a fun, hands-on introduction to Tahoe fishing in a relaxed evening window. Starting March 1, Family Charters provide a more affordable option than our standard trips while still delivering a fully guided experience with professional equipment and expert instruction.
